summary: Mostly not, on BTC, ETH and SOL. Bullish, hidden bullish and bearish divergences did the same as random entries on 1h, 4h and daily. That held whether the signal needed 1, 2 or 3 oscillators or came from RSI alone. One result holds without its strongest stretch, and it runs against the signal: on daily candles in uptrends, price did worse than random after a Bullish 2+ oscillators divergence.

verdicts.text: Same as random on 1h, 4h and daily, for both Any bullish and regular Bullish. On 1h it fired on 11,036 candles across the three pairs and still landed inside the luck band.
Same as random on 1h, 4h and daily. On daily it fired too rarely to judge uptrends and downtrends on their own.
Same as random on 1h, 4h and daily overall. On daily in downtrends, shorts beat random, but only because of signals between Apr 26 and Jun 22, 2022.
On 4h, price did 0.79% worse than random 20 candles after the signal. Without four signals on May 5–11, 2022, during the Terra collapse, it was the same as random.

verdicts.use: Any bullish divergence on daily (1+ oscillator)
verdicts.text: Price did 2.81% worse than random 20 days after the signal. The gap rests on 13 signals between Apr 23 and Jun 17, 2022. Without them, it was the same as random.

notes: Requiring more oscillators cuts the number of signals sharply. On 1h, Bullish 1+ oscillator fired on 14,417 candles and Bullish 3+ oscillators on 1,537. RSI divergence alone fired on 1,315, slightly fewer than 3+. All three landed inside the luck band 20 candles later, so the extra filtering gave fewer entries but not better ones.

Twenty candles after an Any bullish 2+ oscillators signal on 1h, price was 0.06% ahead of random entries. The luck band ran from -0.06% to 0.07%, across 2,719 separate moves. It read the same in uptrends and in downtrends. Hidden bullish 2+ on 1h beat random in downtrends by 0.13%, but only because of five signals on Jan 13, 2023, and at no other horizon.

On daily, Bullish 2+ oscillators matched random overall, but uptrends and downtrends split. In uptrends, price did 7.79% worse than random 20 days after the signal. That held without its strongest stretch and at 50 and 100 candles. It rests on 30 separate moves, the minimum this data judges. In downtrends it was 4.4% worse, but only because of signals between Apr 24 and May 28, 2022.

Shorting on Any bearish 2+ oscillators on daily also splits by trend. In downtrends, shorts beat random by 3.53% after 20 days. That gap rests on 12 signals between Apr 26 and Jun 22, 2022, and shows only at 10 and 20 candles. In uptrends the short was the same as random. On 1h and 4h it was the same as random overall.

On 4h, Bullish 3+ oscillators did 0.79% worse than random, and also worse at 10 and 100 candles. Four signals on May 5–11, 2022, during the Terra collapse, carry it. On daily, RSI bullish divergence and Bullish 3+ oscillators fire too rarely to judge uptrends and downtrends on their own. Their pooled result, same as random, is all the data shows.

For a long DCA bot on these pairs, a divergence start condition timed entries no better than a random candle. The DCA orders and take profit decide the outcome. Raising the oscillator count gives fewer deals without better timing. A daily bullish divergence during an uptrend came before further weakness. That is a reason to leave it out of a daily long bot, not to add it as a filter.
